# Fixture P3-PASS-ANOMALY

On a foggy mountain footpath, a brass bell rings once whenever someone steps across the painted boundary stone. The hikers test the rule from the safe side; the bell stays silent until a boot crosses. When their friend is separated by the fog, An asks the group to remain behind the stone and rings the bell with a trekking pole. The sound returns from the far side, guiding the friend back without another crossing. The group leaves together and paints the boundary clearly for the next hikers.
